verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 4 remains sound. The added end-to-end coverage invokes main() for all five verdicts on both alert routes, checks the exact sole GITHUB_OUTPUT record including its terminating newline, and on the same invocation verifies that stdout contains only the expected coarse class and excludes verdict, detail, expiry, and days-left data. The temporary output file is pre-created, so deleting the write produces an assertion failure rather than a harness crash; exact split-line and newline assertions also catch duplication, widening, and unterminated output. I found no diff-scoped correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue. With no prior-round findings and no new findings, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
